data.exact_reserve_text: The prior accident year experience has been less benign. Deterioration on the earned and booked position on some accounts has had a negative impact on the Syndicate's result for the year. In particular, deterioration on certain Marine Insurance segments has dragged back the performance of this class. Corrective action has now been applied to this account to re-structure its composition and return it to the profitable performance it has historically produced. The legacy Solicitor's Professional Indemnity portfolio, from which the Syndicate has now exited, also exhibited some deterioration in the first half of the calendar year based on claims development on prior years' exposures. Recent development has been more stable but reserves have nonetheless been strengthened. The 2013 underwriting Year of Account ("YOA") of the Syndicate has been reinsured to close into the 2014 YOA of the Syndicate with a total recognised profit of GBP 6.3m.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Deterioration in legacy Solicitor's Professional Indemnity portfolio based on claims development on prior years' exposures
Total recognised profit on closure of 2013 underwriting Year of Account

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced mixed prior year development in 2015. Overall gross reserves strengthened by GBP 11.763 million, primarily driven by adverse claims development in certain Marine Insurance segments and the legacy Solicitor's Professional Indemnity portfolio. However, the 2013 Year of Account closed with a net recognized profit of GBP 6.3 million, indicating a favorable release for that specific year.

data.data_quality_notes: The overall gross prior year development was calculated from the claims development triangle for underwriting years 2013 and 2012, as the 'Claims incurred in prior accident years' line in Note 11 is a component of current year claims incurred rather than the total prior year reserve movement. Narrative text indicates specific LOB deteriorations and a net profit on a closed year of account, leading to a 'mixed' direction. Specific LOB movements are not quantified in the report.
